title: Новые визиты (INSERT ... SELECT)
setup:
INSERT INTO menu VALUES (19, 2, 'greek pizza', 800);
INSERT INTO menu (id, pizzeria_id, pizza_name, price) VALUES ((SELECT MAX(id) FROM menu) + 1, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Dominos'), 'sicilian pizza', 900);
verify: SELECT person_id, pizzeria_id, visit_date FROM person_visits ORDER BY person_id, pizzeria_id, visit_date

positive.sql: INSERT INTO person_visits (id, person_id, pizzeria_id, visit_date) SELECT (SELECT MAX(id) FROM person_visits) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY person.id), person.id, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Dominos'), '2022-02-24' FROM person WHERE person.name = 'Denis' OR person.name = 'Irina';

negative.sql: INSERT INTO person_visits (id, person_id, pizzeria_id, visit_date) SELECT (SELECT MAX(id) FROM person_visits) + person.id, person.id, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Dominos'), '2022-02-24' FROM person WHERE person.name = 'Denis';
